title: 12 Pasukan, Satu Impian
notes: Source of truth for Episode 7. Timings locked to the measured 1.0x e7_* TTS durations with 22f (0.73s) buffers between lines. Debt stays RM326,500; stadium seizure stays frozen; captaincy stays vacant.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.label: JURULATIH
lines.text: Gerak, gerak! Musim ni kita takde masa nak main-main. Cepat sikit!
lines.en: Move, move! This season we have no time to mess around. Faster!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.label: NARRATOR
lines.text: Divisyen lima. Dua belas kelab, satu tempat je naik. Tekanan baru.
lines.en: Division five. Twelve clubs, only one goes up. New pressure.

lines.speaker: bos
lines.label: BOS
lines.text: Perjanjian cakap jelas. Stadium beku sampai musim tamat. Kita takde pilihan.
lines.en: The agreement is clear. The stadium stays frozen until the season ends. We have no choice.

lines.speaker: rizal
lines.label: RIZAL
lines.text: Weh, dengar tak? Metro Selatan beli striker luar. Siapa nak lawan?
lines.en: Hey, did you hear? Metro Selatan bought a foreign striker. Who's going to face them?

lines.speaker: azam
lines.label: AZAM
lines.text: Dengar. Kita lawan diorang kat padang, bukan kat kedai kopi.
lines.en: I heard. We face them on the pitch, not at the coffee shop.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.label: JURULATIH
lines.text: Latihan ni macam matchday. Satu silap, terus kena marah.
lines.en: This training is like matchday. One mistake and you get an earful.

lines.speaker: bos
lines.label: BOS
lines.text: Tiket semua dah jual. Tinggal kau orang kat padang. Buktikan dekat aku.
lines.en: The tickets are all sold. All that's left is you on the pitch. Prove it to me.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.label: NARRATOR
lines.text: Dua belas kelab, satu impian. Jalan keluar? Cuma satu. Siapa jatuh dulu?
lines.en: Twelve clubs, one dream. And the way out? Only one. Who falls first?
